summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscated Node script that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, marks it executable, and uses it to run a ~728 KB bundled file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and is heavily obfuscated (rotated string/constant array via a `WV8StW` shift rotator, `_0x`-prefixed identifiers, large numeric constant pool) — its contents are unrelated to the advertised React marketing-widget purpose and are executed only under the downloaded Bun runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. The React widget source under `src/`/`dist/` serves as benign cover. The package is published under the `@servicetitan/marketing-widgets` name, referencing `github.com/servicetitan/marketing-integration-widgets`, but ships this install-time dropper chain, consistent with scope impersonation or a scope compromise of a legitimate vendor namespace. Installing the package auto-runs the dropper via `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
